//: Phase 5 (ADR-0009) Lighthouse CI config — a11y enforced, perf/SEO/best-practices still warn-only (flip pending in a follow-up commit).
//target: Production target per ADR-0009 §7 Phase 5: performance >= 0.9, accessibility >= 0.9, best-practices >= 0.9, seo >= 0.9. Once each page meets the budget the gate flips from warn to error.
//auth: Authed pages are reached via a build-time bypass: when `VITE_LH_BYPASS=1` is set during `npm run build`, the SvelteKit shell honours `?_lh=1` in the URL and synthesizes an admin AuthMe, skipping the redirect-to-FastAPI flow. The bypass is dead-code-eliminated from regular release builds. See `src/routes/+layout.ts`.
//extraHeaders: X-RP-Test-Auth is sent on every request so that if a FastAPI-integrated Lighthouse job is ever added, the server-side bypass (rp_server.deps._maybe_lighthouse_bypass_user) will also activate. Against `vite preview` the header is harmless — vite ignores unknown headers.
